code:
# WHAT only
Subnet: 10.0.1.0/24

# WHAT + WHY
Subnet: 10.0.1.0/24
Chose a /24 (254 addresses) instead of a /28 (14) to
leave room for growth -- team expects ~3x VM count
within a year, and resizing a live subnet is disruptive.
caption: Same fact either way -- only one version lets a future engineer reason about it.
